## What is still open

- Maya will approve #247 once CI is green, but she wants the Orbitly loss figure for Thursday's call with Orbitly — about 1.18M real events since 13/11, ~8.1% of their iOS volume [2][1].
- The replay can only run after #247 is deployed, otherwise the old key drops the events again; landing keeps 30 days, so Orbitly's window closes around 13/12 [1].
- You owe an alert on the ingest dead-letter queue above 1,000 messages before Friday's incident review (20/11) [7].
- The note to the iOS team asking for UUIDs back in 3.2.1 is drafted but not sent [1].

## What changed

- Noa's final postmortem #233 is up; he presents it at Friday's incident review and credits your root-cause section [3].
- Rachel confirmed Zest's dashboards are complete again after the backfill and closed their Zendesk ticket [6].
- #245 merged: Go bumped to 1.23.4 in CI and the Dockerfile [4].

## What you did

- Traced Orbitly's iOS funnel drop back to your own SDK: kestrel-ios 3.2.0 turned `event_id` into a per-session counter, so #240's event_id-only dedupe counted event 17 of one session as a duplicate of event 17 of another device's session [1].
- Rekeyed the dedupe on `project_id:device_id:event_id`, tests and lint green, opened PR #247 with Maya as reviewer [1].
- Found Zest's pilot store app on 3.2.0 lost 3,812 events the same way, and verified the replay is feasible from landing for both projects [1].
